thread:
incident-bot: HIGH SLO ALERT — p99 latency breach detected for service `model-api:generate` in us-west-2. p99=2780ms (SLO=2000ms) over the last 5m. Streaming endpoints show increased chunk delivery delays. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/dash/rt-latency?panel=streaming. Paging oncall now.

maria (oncall): oncall here, acknowledging. I'll pull up graphs and traces. tagging @soren for infra correlation.

soren (sre): looking at infra metrics — queue_depth and runtime_work_ms both spike at 13:02 UTC. KV cache miss rate jumps ~3x at same time. No increase in 5xx, mostly tail latency and streaming chunk gaps.

charlie (eng-runtime): we had a quantized variant (quant-v2) rolled out at 11:30. Possible kernel selection edge-case with long sequences causing host-side prep stalls. grabbing logs now.

maria (oncall): quick mitigation options? scale, rollback variant, or throttle long streams?

soren (sre): immediate: scale up model-api pods and reduce batching window to cut down queuing. Longer: rollback quant-v2 if confirmed.

charlie (eng-runtime): starting investigation. reproducing locally with sequence length distribution from the traces. Also watching for memory spikes on the host.

maria (oncall): running quick commands to scale and limit batching: `kubectl scale deployment model-api --replicas=6 -n prod`

soren (sre): applied a temporary route-level rate cap for streaming requests > 60s. command: `rwctl routes update model-api --stream-max-duration=60s` — this should limit long sessions queuing up.

charlie (eng-runtime): grabbing a sample of the problematic logs:```
[13:02:14] WARN kernel_selector.cpp: alloc workspace 0x7f8a1b000 delaying 120ms for seq_len=2048
[13:02:15] ERROR runtime_host.cpp: copy_to_gpu stalled, retrying (attempt 3)
[13:02:16] INFO kv_cache.cpp: miss storm: keys=12456 miss_rate=0.78
```

maria (oncall): any visible customer impact? 5xx rate stable?

dana (support): no spike in 5xx. One customer ticket (Acme Corp) about streaming UI freezes reported at 13:05. Marking as P2 for targeted outreach.

charlie (eng-runtime): hypothesis confirmed — quant-v2 triggers different kernel path that occasionally allocates larger temporary buffers for token padding; when sequence length distribution is spiky it causes host-side memcpy stalls and increases per-request latency. I'll initiate an immediate traffic rollback of quant-v2.

charlie (eng-runtime): rolling variant back: `rwctl model set-variant model-api --variant fp16-202603 --force` -> starting gradual switch to fp16-202603 then to 100% if green.

incident-bot: Action taken: routing update applied. Monitoring p95/p99 and streaming chunk latency panels.

maria (oncall): p99 dropped to ~980ms within 3 minutes after rollback. Streaming chunk delay median improved but tail still shows occasional blips (~1.2s).

charlie (eng-runtime): root-cause summary: quant-v2 kernel path does extra per-token workspace allocation under certain padding patterns; this increases host-to-device memcpy variance and creates tail stalls under spiky sequence workloads. PR with fix and a safer kernel selection rule: https://github.com/redwood/eng-runtime/pull/3821 — patch targets runtime kernel selection and adds guards.

elena (product): I'll prepare a brief customer note for customers heavy on streaming workloads (low-latency use). Recommend targeted comms to Acme and any customers with >100 streaming sessions/day.

dana (support): created ticket TICKET-4823 for Acme outreach and added logs/trace ids. Support will coordinate EOD follow-up.

maria (oncall): handoff: I'll be leaving in 20m. @soren will take oncall follow-up for the postmortem and metric collection. Notes for next oncall: rollback id `route-change-1812345679-rollback`, relevant traces in s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1812345679/*. Also we should add a temporary alert to catch KV cache miss storms.

soren (sre): taking over. I'll capture flamegraphs and schedule a 1-hour debug session with runtime team to validate the PR. Also will run a synthetic streaming load test to ensure tail stability.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — paging mitigated, impact reduced. Severity downgraded to SEV3. Postmortem required: https://redwood.incidents/1812345679.

maria (oncall): thanks team. leaving notes in the incident doc and attaching screenshots. I'll be available on call for 10 more minutes then off.

soren (sre): acknowledged, continuing follow-ups. collecting additional KV cache and batch latency histograms now.

(END of thread)
